features.name: Agent task flow mapping
features.description: A framework for understanding and testing agent behavior through message arrival, agent actions, output verification (message, review request, or intervention), and multi-turn handling.
caveats: Data may change between turns without agent knowledge
Requires consideration of state changes in busy ERP environments

features.name: Suite setup strategy
features.description: Creating custom test data rather than relying on demo data because agents may have knowledge of public demo data from model training, requiring custom master records to validate agent behavior.
caveats: Agents may recognize public demo data from training
Custom records needed for accurate testing

features.name: Data sets and YAML-driven tests
features.description: AL tests driven by YAML data-driven test specifications, with library agent component automating every step of the agent flow.
caveats: Agent session runs separately and cannot be directly controlled
Light blue portions are automatable; dark blue agent execution is not

features.name: Extensible framework with atomic functions
features.description: Building blocks designed to be fully customizable, allowing users to arrange components as needed without requiring the full framework.
caveats: Framework is optional
Atomic functions can be combined independently

features.name: YAML test definition syntax
features.description: Structured YAML format with suit setup, test name, description, and turns array, supporting predefined sections that map to agent actions and free-format sections for custom data.
caveats: Predefined sections are extensible
Free-format sections require AL code implementation

features.name: Turn setup section
features.description: Predefined YAML section allowing creation of test data before agent execution, supporting simulation of existing state or interim changes for agent pickup.
caveats: Fully implemented in AL
Free-format custom properties accessible via AL code

features.name: Message arrival with attachments
features.description: YAML section allowing specification of task query with sender, title, body, and file attachments via resources or AL-generated reports converted to attachments.
caveats: Dynamic attachment generation requires custom AL code
Supports both resource-based and report-based attachments

features.name: Expected data verification
features.description: YAML section for verifying agent output, specifying intervention request type with suggested action codes and free-format payload for programmatic validation of created records.
caveats: Cannot currently check intervention request message text
Verification of created records requires custom AL implementation

features.name: Multi-turn conversation testing
features.description: Support for multi-turn agent conversations by specifying user interventions as input, allowing mock approval and instructions for agent continuation.
caveats: Follows same syntax as initial turn
User interventions are mocked through YAML

features.name: Date and datetime placeholders in data-driven tests
features.description: Dynamic date calculation in YAML test data using placeholder formulas that automatically adjust to the current work date, eliminating the need to manually update hardcoded dates in test files.
caveats: Placeholders are not specific to agent testing and can be used in data-driven tests outside of in tests

features.name: Agent picker in test execution
features.description: Functionality allowing tests to run against different agents by changing agent instructions and model configuration through three lines of test setup code.

features.name: Get eval suit setup data input keyword
features.description: Built-in keyword in AL test library that retrieves YAML-defined setup data for a test suite, automatically parsing properties and supporting large file separation.

features.name: Test library data creation and field defaulting
features.description: Test libraries automatically default unspecified fields like posting groups and units of measure, allowing tests to specify only the fields relevant to the agent being tested.
caveats: Only specify necessary fields for stability and to shield from product changes

features.name: Suite setup completion caching
features.description: Suite setup code executes only once per test suite run (or across multiple suite/codeunit runs), controlled by the developer through code, avoiding redundant setup execution.
caveats: Developer controls execution timing through code

features.name: Run turn and wait keyword
features.description: Built-in helper method that provides both the input message and user intervention to the agent in a turn, handling query parsing, property import, attachment processing, and file insertion.

features.name: Get expected data keyword for validation
features.description: Built-in keyword that reads expected results from YAML test data, enabling assertions against agent behavior outcomes without using traditional assert statements.

features.name: Error reason field for test failure logging
features.description: Alternative to traditional asserts; tests check data and accumulate issues in an error reason field, returning true or false to indicate pass/fail and continue or stop the test.

features.name: Finalize turn keyword with history logging
features.description: Built-in wrapper keyword that stores turn results and task output to history log, checks for next turn definition, and enables viewing error details in a fact box showing why the test failed.
caveats: Fact box showing error text was recently added and may not be visible in older demos

features.name: Log download with serialized task output
features.description: Downloaded log files contain serialized output including tasks, steps, inputs, expected data, error messages, and other logged outputs that can be uploaded to Azure AI Foundry for LLM judge analysis.

features.name: Library agent public methods for customization
features.description: Agent test library exposes 27 public methods supporting asynchronous operations (ending with 'and wait') to automate every agent interaction, including wait for task complete for programmatic action invocation.
caveats: Methods are well-documented; developers encouraged to report missing methods
